dct_description_sm: Surficial geology mapping, involving both airphot interpretation, and ground truthing was undertaken to assess the nature of the surficial material cover, and how this related to aspects of permafrost (salinity, ground ice content, active layer depth) and susceptibility to erosion and mass wasting.
